_about: Example company list. Copy this file to companies.json and edit it. Every entry is a public career site read through the adapter named in ats. Set enabled to false to pause one. Run: node fetch-jobs.mjs --check to test every board without saving anything.

companies.name: Binary Defense
companies.note: boardId is the GUID in the company's Paylocity job board address, slug is the name at the end.

companies.name: Ntiva
companies.note: company and boardId come from the company's UKG job board address.

companies.name: Arctic Wolf
companies.note: Workday sites are paced and stop for the run at the first HTTP 429. Keep searchTerms short.

companies.name: USAJobs
companies.note: Needs a free API key from developer.usajobs.gov saved with tools\save-secret.ps1 -Path secrets\usajobs-key.dat. Put your own email in contactEmail; USAJobs requires it in the request header. Then set enabled to true.

companies.name: Remotive
companies.note: Public API, about 16 jobs, delayed 24 hours. Their terms allow at most 4 calls a day and ask you to link back to Remotive.
